steps.label: Leakage
steps.sub: Only use data before the cutoff

code:
past = orders[orders.order_date < cutoff]
lo = cutoff - pd.Timedelta(days=30)
w = past[past.order_date >= lo]
g = w.groupby("customer_id")["amount"]
feat = g.agg(["size", "sum"])
caption: Simplified from the run. Cutoff 2025-03-01.

eyebrow: The same idea in PySpark, illustrative
code:
w = past.filter(
  F.col("order_date")
  >= F.date_sub(cutoff, 30))
feat = w.groupBy("customer_id").agg(
  F.count("*").alias("orders_30d"),
  F.sum("amount").alias("spend_30d"))
